author: Summary of the verified items in this tracker
headline: AI announcements by UAE free zones, January to October 2026

findings.title: Zone-wide AI programmes
findings.text: DIFC announced it will become an AI-Native financial centre (USD 3.5bn stated value, 25,000 jobs). ADGM reported AI live in 25 business functions with an AED 400m roadmap to 2029.

findings.title: AI infrastructure and compute
findings.text: DIEZ and VOLT are building an AI-ready data centre in Dubai Silicon Oasis (29 MW, then 100 MW). Innovation City opened a sovereign GPU data centre for licensees, and KEZAD signed an AI manufacturing centre (ROX).

findings.title: AI in licensing and registration
findings.text: Innovation City runs company registration with Salesforce Agentforce AI agents, SPC Free Zone operates an AI-powered licensing system, and ADGM resolves about 25% of enquiries instantly with AI.

findings.title: AI company and talent ecosystems
findings.text: SPC Free Zone reports 1,000+ AI-related companies and DIFC 1,933 AI, FinTech and innovation firms. Training and founder programmes ran at ADGM Academy, Shams, Dubai AI Campus, Hub71 and Dubai CommerCity (IIT Madras centre).
